propositions: runner.py contains a 371-line method at its C901 complexity ceiling; comment triage and removal of stale/duplicate documentation recovers ~46 lines, providing runway for 4-5 additional stories without another split

Three sites contradict each other on Anthropic 400 conditions (extended thinking + native output constraint) while structured.py:228-238 labels that rationale as stale/a relic; conflicting sites must be reconciled conservatively to match current runtime
The extra_tools field is live (wired in completion_recovery.py and runs.py, asserted in tests) but documented as always-None; its stale comment must be corrected in place, not removed

capabilities.py:166-198 is a structurally complete ADR (security posture, three numbered bounds, accepted limitation on web-search capability) but no ADR in the corpus documents it; must be relocated to a new ADR >=0063
providers.py:3-16 duplicates ADR 0059 section 1 verbatim including file:line citations and should be collapsed to a one-line citation
AWS-cost capability matrix (capabilities.py:295-316) and rejected-alternative warning (capabilities.py:269-281) are measured facts and load-bearing invariants that must remain verbatim
